articles.title: Wall Street transfer agents lobby SEC, warning that third-party tokens pose risks to market integrity
articles.snippet: The Securities Transfer Association, an industry group for transfer agents, said company-authorized tokenization should receive preferential treatment under future rules.

articles.title: SBI Holdings' blockchain initiative pivots to Solana for tokenization, stablecoin issuance
articles.snippet: The SBI Solana Global joint venture now includes the Solana Foundation, the Swiss organization that oversees the layer-1 network.

articles.title: Japan’s SBI to launch yen stablecoin lending with 3% yield
articles.snippet: SBI VC Trade will open JPYSC lending applications on July 16, offering an initial 3% annual rate for a 12-week term without deposit insurance.

articles.title: Apple Sues OpenAI, Claims Former Employees Stole Trade Secrets
articles.snippet: Apple alleges former employees took confidential designs, supplier information, and engineering files before joining OpenAI.
